evidence.excerpt: Settings or surface-specific configuration must support mapping Persona defaults to Interview stages/phases, Requirements Builder steps/passes, Orchestrator node/package/lane/seam mappings, and Multi-Pass review passes. These editors should also allow platform/model selection per mapping and show compatibility warnings.
The Persona editor MUST show provider support state for Persona controls, with supported / partially supported / unsupported states and editing, warning, or disabled behavior per control.

When a run is active, the UI must display requested Persona, effective Persona, selection source/reason, effective platform, effective model, effective variant/effort when present, and skipped Persona controls when applicable.

The GUI must never imply that a provider honored a Persona control when it did not; skipped or clamped controls must disclose control name, requested value, effective value, and reason, and runtime limitations must surface inline and in history.

The Persona editor fields section enumerates editable Persona properties such as default_platform, default_model, default_variant, temperature, top_p, reasoning_effort, talkativeness, preferred_tools, discouraged_tools, tool_usage_guidance, and aliases.

Assistant Chat planning controls expose Plan and Deep Plan, show plan thoroughness, keep a sticky plan panel with a normalized TODO list, allow TODO revision before approval, and begin execution only after explicit approval.
